title: Contexture
summary: CONTEXTURE, noun The manner of interweaving several parts into one body; the disposition and union of the constituent parts of a thing, with respect to each other; composition of parts; constitution;

inlines.v: CONTEXTURE, noun The manner of interweaving several parts into one body; the disposition and union of the constituent parts of a thing, with respect to each other; composition of parts; constitution; as a silk of admirable contexture He was not of any delicate contexture; his limbs rather sturdy than dainty.
